title: Powder Tower
note: The two open portals occupy the east and west facades. Their transverse ridge and the eccentric mapped stair turret preserve the exact local frame rather than defaulting the gateway to north. The adjoining Municipal House connection is separate architecture; the gate itself retains a walkable passage and native ground-contact piers. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.
